name: Tanya
headline: A curious mind. A connected perspective.
intro: I'm a software developer with a diverse skill set and the courage to begin again, hoping to build a career and a sense of belonging in Norway.
about: In September 2025, I moved to Norway with my experience as a software developer, a diverse skill set, and hope for a new chapter. Starting again means more than finding a job: it means learning a language, understanding Norwegian culture, and finding my place in a new community. Through language learning and adapting to the local working environment, I'm building that connection one step at a time. My experience spans Salesforce, frontend development, DevOps, analytics, data engineering, Java, and application support, but what I hope to bring to a team goes beyond technology: curiosity, care, and a willingness to keep growing. I'm looking for an opportunity to contribute, earn trust, and build a meaningful career in the country I'm learning to call home.

roles.label: Analytics
roles.story: BI & Data specialist for procurement with 4+ years of experience integrating ERP, supplier, purchase order, invoice, contract, category, and financial data to create reliable spend visibility and decision support. Skilled in SQL, Python, Power BI, data modelling, master data, vendor reporting, and data quality across procurement. Experienced in engineering source-to-pay data with ERP and building governed data foundations, procurement dashboards, and automated workflows that support sourcing decisions, supplier performance, KPI reporting, and continuous improvement.

projects.title: The insight workspace
projects.subtitle: A clearer picture of performance.
projects.summary: An illustrative analytics workspace for exploring a fictional business's monthly performance.
projects.challenge: How can a decision-maker understand a trend without losing the context behind the numbers?
projects.approach: Organize a small, explicitly synthetic dataset into comparable metrics. Make the time range adjustable and give each visual a clear label.
projects.outcome: A live chart demonstration with monthly, quarterly, and annual views. No business outcomes or personal achievements are claimed.

projects.title: From source to signal
projects.subtitle: A more considered data journey.
projects.summary: A conceptual data pipeline showing how raw inputs can become validated, usable information.
projects.challenge: How should a pipeline separate extraction, validation, transformation, and serving?
projects.approach: Define the responsibilities at each stage and expose clear boundaries rather than mixing processing and presentation.
projects.outcome: An illustrative architecture, not an implemented production pipeline or a claim of employment experience.

projects.title: Small details. Better systems.
projects.subtitle: Structure that makes room for change.
projects.summary: A software design concept focused on readable contracts, input validation, and testable behavior.
projects.challenge: How do small services remain easy to change as requirements grow?
projects.approach: Separate transport, validation, and persistence. Test observable behavior and keep public contracts explicit.
projects.outcome: This portfolio's working backend is Python. This example illustrates software design and does not claim an implemented Java project.

projects.title: The operational overview
projects.subtitle: Less noise. More forward motion.
projects.summary: An illustrative workflow for organizing priorities and reducing ambiguity in operational handoffs.
projects.challenge: How can teams see ownership, status, and next actions in a single view?
projects.approach: Use a compact workflow with explicit stages, responsibilities, and a consistent reporting cadence.
projects.outcome: A sample operational model. Efficiency gains and work-history claims are intentionally not included.
